preconditions.description: Grid dimensions and number of actions are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 and 1 <= r1 <= r2 <= n and 1 <= c1 <= c2 <= m for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions)
preconditions.description: Each action type and coordinates are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= r1 <= r2 <= n-1 and 2 <= c1 <= c2 <= m-1 for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t == 1)
preconditions.description: Barrier placement actions have valid coordinates within the grid.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= r1 <= r2 <= n-1 and 2 <= c1 <= c2 <= m-1 for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t == 2)
preconditions.description: Barrier removal actions have valid coordinates within the grid.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == 'Yes' if is_path_feasible(r1, c1, r2, c2) else output[i] == 'No' for i, (t, r1, c1, r2, c2) in enumerate(actions) if t == 3)
postconditions.description: For each walk attempt (action with t=3), the output indicates whether the path is feasible.
